comment: Macro slots per flavor (spec ME3): account macros and macros per character. A flavor not listed here uses Retail's values (core.kb.limits_known says False) and the Macro Editor marks its slots unconfirmed. scripts/refresh_kb.py writes a flavor's entry from its client dump (source "client dump <flavor> <build>"); an entry marked provisional is a copy of another flavor's until its own dump exists.

_forever_.provisional: copied from _retail_ until a _forever_ dump exists
